content: Aɛdař n řxedmet di Zzawect Tameqqrant

Awarni řami kemmřen s man aya marra, ffɣen-dd marra ayt n Israil nni tuɣa din iǧan ɣar tneddam n Yahuda u arẓin imayḍuten iqeddsen, hedmen tirebbin n cwarti uca kksen řegɛudi d iɛalṭaren zi marra Yahuda d Binyamin. Ammu i ggin uřa di Ifrayim d Manassa ařami tt kemmřen. Awarni uya ɛeqben marra ayt n Israil, kuř ijj ɣar wagřa nnes, marra nitni ɣar tneddam nsen.

Ḥizqiya issbedd tirbiɛin n ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen ɛlaḥṣab tirbiɛin nsen, kuř ijj ɛlaḥsab tasexxart nnes: ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen i tɣarṣt n wecmaḍ u i tewhibin n řehna, ḥima ad sexxaren, ad qadan u ad ssɛuǧan di tewwura n řemrageḥ n řɛeskar n SIDI.

Netta iwca uřa d tawhibt n ujeǧid zeg wagřa nnes i tɣarṣa n wecmaḍ, i tɣarṣa n wecmaḍ ɣar tuffut u ɣar tmeddit, uřa d tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ i wussan n ssebt, i uyuren imaynuten u i řeɛyudat ittwaggen, am mammec tura di Ccariɛa n SIDI.
Netta inna i řgens, i imezdaɣ n Urcalim, ad wehhben tasɣart n ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen, ḥima ina zemmaren ad iřin jehden di tɣuri n Ccariɛa n SIDI.
Umi dd-iffeɣ wawař nni, iwyen-dd ayt n Israil s ufeyyeḍ zeg usuffeɣ amezwaru n imendi, n binu n jdid d zzect d tamment u zi marra řɣiǧet n yeyyar. Iwyen uřa d řeɛcur zi marra s ufeyyeḍ.

Tarwa n Israil d Yahuda, inni izedɣen di tneddam n Yahuda, iwyen uřa d řeɛcur zeg ifunasen u zeg wuǧi uřa d řeɛcur n tewhibin iqeddsen nni tuɣa ssqeddsen i SIDI, AREBBI nsen, uca wcin ten, ggin zzaysen iɛurrac.
Deg uyur wiss třata bdan nitni ad zzaysen ggen iɛurrac zi tisi u deg uyur wiss sebɛa kemmřen tt.
Umi Ḥizqiya d řḥukkam usin-dd u ẓrin iɛurrac nni, barken SIDI d řgens nnes Israil.
Isseqsa Ḥizqiya ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen x iɛurrac nni.

Ɛazarya, akehhan ameqqran zi taddart n Ṣaduq yarra-dd xas, inna: “Zeg wami dd-nekkar ad nawi tawhibt n usgeɛɛed ɣar Taddart n SIDI, aqa ɣarneɣ min ɣa necc ař tyawant uca ɛad iqqim aṭṭas iceṭṭ, maɣar SIDI ibarek řgens nnes, ařami iqqim řqedd-a n waṭṭas iceṭṭ.”
Xenni inna Ḥizqiya, ad sswejden ixxamen n Taddart n SIDI, u nitni sswejden ten.
Nitni ssidfen tawhibt n usgeɛɛed d řeɛcur d tewhibin iqeddsen din s řaman. Kunanya, Alawi, ameḥḍay, d umas Cimɛi, wenni d wiss tnayen, tuɣa aten x man aya marra.

Yaḥiyil, Ɛazazya, Naḥat, Ɛasa’il, Yarimut, Yuzabad, Iliyil, Yismaxya, Maḥat, Banaya tuɣa aten d iweqqafen sadu ufus n Kunanya d Cimɛi, umas, x řumur n ujeǧid Ḥizqiya u n Ɛazarya, ameḥḍay n Taddart n AREBBI.
Quri, mmis n Yimna, Alawi, aɛessas n tewwart ɣar uɣezdis n ccarq, ittwagg x tewhibin n řxaḍar n AREBBI, ḥima ad ibḍa tawhibt n usgeɛɛed n SIDI d tewhibin iqeddsen qaɛ.
Ɛadan, Minyamin, Yecuɛa, Camɛiya, Amarya d Cakunya bedden s řmanet ɣar uɣezdis nnes ɛlaḥṣab tirbiɛin nsen, ḥima ad wezzɛen di tneddam n ikehhanen i aytmatsen, am i imeqqranen, am i imeẓyanen,

maca war iǧi i yinni ittwazemmemen di lista n jjadira n yeryazen i ɣar iǧa třata n iseggʷusa sennej, aqa marra inni dd-yusin ɣar Taddart n SIDI i řxedmet n kuř ass i wass nni, i řxedmet nsen di tsexxart nsen, ɛlaḥsab tirbiɛin nsen.
Azemmen di lista n jjadira n ikehhanen tuɣa-t ɛlaḥṣab tudrin n ibabaten nsen, maca azemmem n Ilawiyyen zi ɛicrin n iseggʷusa sennej, tuɣa-t ɛlaḥsab tasexxart nsen, ɛlaḥsab tirbiɛin nsen.

Nitni wezzɛen i yinni ittwazemmemen di lista n jjadira ak-d marra tarwa nsen d temɣarin nsen d iḥenjiren nsen d tḥenjirin nsen zi marra agraw n řgens, maɣar nitni ggin s řaman umi ssqeddsen ixef nsen s tidett.

Jar warrawen n Harun, ikehhanen, deg iyyaren n ddmani n tneddam nsen, di kuř tandint, tuɣa din iryazen nni ittwazemmemen s ismawen nsen ḥima ad wcen tasɣart i marra awtem jar ikehhanen u i marra inni ittwazemmemen di lista n jjadira jar Ilawiyyen.
Ammu i igga Ḥizqiya di marra Yahuda. Netta igga min iǧan icnan d iseggden d nican zzat i wudem n SIDI, AREBBI nnes.
Marra řxedmet i ibda di ṭṭweɛ n tsexxart n Taddart n AREBBI u di ṭṭweɛ n Ccariɛa d tewṣeyyet ḥima ad yarzu ammu AREBBI, igga i-tt s marra uř nnes uca ifřeḥ.
